scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:admin
scripts.deploy:cssa: cp deploy/cssa/branding.js branding.js && cp deploy/cssa/wrangler.toml wrangler.toml && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:cumt: cp deploy/cumt/branding.js branding.js && cp deploy/cumt/wrangler.toml wrangler.toml && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:cssa && npm run deploy:cumt
scripts.setup: cp deploy/template/branding.js branding.js && cp deploy/template/wrangler.toml wrangler.toml && echo 'Template config copied. Edit branding.js and wrangler.toml before deploying.'
